svg.text: JORDAN ELLIS
Columbus, OH | jordan.ellis@example.com
Education & Credentials
M.S. Nursing Leadership | North Valley University | 2018
B.S. Nursing | North Valley University | 2009
Professional Profile
Registered nurse with experience in medical-surgical nursing, post-acute care, charge nursing, staff development and nursing
management. Committed to supporting patients and families through clear communication and coordinated care.
Experienced in scheduling, precepting, documentation, discharge planning and collaboration with physicians and other
disciplines. Seeking continued growth in nursing leadership while contributing clinical experience and an understanding of
day-to-day unit operations.
Professional Experience
Nurse Manager | Meadow Hospital | 2020–present
Manage the daily operation of a 24-bed medical-surgical unit with 32 nursing staff. Responsibilities include preparing
schedules, adjusting assignments to reflect patient acuity, reviewing coverage, approving leave, completing performance
reviews and supporting recruitment and orientation. Meet with charge nurses to discuss staffing concerns, patient
transitions and outstanding issues from the previous shift. Participate in hospital operations meetings and communicate
updates to the unit.
Work with nurses, physicians, case managers and families on discharge arrangements and patient education. Co-developed
a discharge teach-back checklist that was adopted across the unit and covers medication instructions, follow-up
appointments and when to seek help. Review the documentation process with staff, discuss barriers during unit meetings
and coordinate follow-up when patients or families need additional clarification before leaving the hospital.
Responsible for staff development, including assigning preceptors, reviewing orientation progress and helping new nurses
become familiar with the unit. Established a structured preceptor assignment process and coached charge nurses on
escalation and handoffs. Maintain competency records, arrange education sessions, support incident debriefs and reinforce
unit procedures. Represent nursing in interdisciplinary discussions about care transitions, coverage and changes to
everyday workflows.
Charge Nurse | Meadow Hospital | 2015–2020
Served as charge nurse while maintaining a patient assignment of four to five patients per shift. Coordinated shift
assignments, admissions, transfers and escalation to the nurse manager or physician. Precepted six new nurses on unit
routines, documentation in Epic and communication with patients and families. Participated in bedside handoffs, assisted
colleagues with difficult situations and ensured outstanding care tasks were communicated to the next shift. Helped orient
float staff to the unit.
Registered Nurse | Lakeview Care Center | 2009–2015
Provided post-acute nursing care, administered medications, completed assessments and maintained patient records.
Coordinated daily care goals with rehabilitation staff and families, attended care-planning discussions and communicated
changes in patient status. Helped patients prepare for transitions home, reinforced discharge instructions and worked with
colleagues to maintain continuity between shifts. Supported new staff learning the facility’s documentation and
communication procedures.
Licensure & Skills
Ohio RN license (active); BLS; Epic; patient education; discharge coordination; Medical-surgical nursing; post-acute care;
patient assessment; medication administration; care planning; Epic documentation; discharge planning; patient and family
education; staffing; scheduling; precepting; competency records; interdisciplinary communication.
